summary: Rain edges this one out on paper — Swampert's Water/Ground coverage hits both Tyranitar and Excadrill for double damage, while Sand's best answer only reliably threatens Pelipper. Close enough that execution matters more than the raw type math.
keyFactors: Swampert's Wave Crash and Earthquake are both super effective against Tyranitar and Excadrill — real double coverage from one Pokémon.
Tyranitar's Stone Edge is super effective against Pelipper specifically, so Sand Offense can pressure Rain's own weather-setter directly.
Excadrill's Earthquake does nothing to Pelipper (Ground moves can't hit Flying types) — Sand's most reliable attacker has a real hole in its coverage against Rain's setter.
Once sandstorm is up, Excadrill's Sand Rush roughly doubles its Speed — faster than anything on Rain's side, so a well-timed switch-in still threatens despite the type disadvantage.
